# ZYXEN

> ZYXEN (zyxen.gr) is a software studio based in Greece. It provides business websites, e-commerce development and support, mobile applications, custom software and automation.

Official website: https://www.zyxen.gr/
Contact: hello@zyxen.gr
The website is in English.

## Services
- [Services and project scopes](https://www.zyxen.gr/services): Deliverables, client inputs and scope boundaries.
- [Business websites](https://www.zyxen.gr/websites): The website package, inclusions and optional care.
- [Umbraco development](https://www.zyxen.gr/services/umbraco-platform-engineering)
- [Web development and technical SEO](https://www.zyxen.gr/services/web-experiences-seo)
- [E-commerce](https://www.zyxen.gr/services/commerce-nopcommerce)
- [Mobile applications](https://www.zyxen.gr/services/flutter-web-mobile)
- [AI integrations and automation](https://www.zyxen.gr/services/ai-integrations)

## Project contributions
- [Portfolio](https://www.zyxen.gr/projects): Each project explains the studio's contribution; inclusion does not imply full project ownership.
- [LED7](https://www.zyxen.gr/projects/led7): Ongoing e-commerce support, technical SEO review and Google Ads management.
- [Artisti Shop](https://www.zyxen.gr/projects/artistishop): Existing-store support, Google Ads review and Merchant Center diagnostics.
- [IPS](https://www.zyxen.gr/projects/ips): Content architecture and technical implementation contribution. Lead agency: Redirect.
